dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts up to 25 specialized personnel appointed under this authority at any given time.
dimensions.evidence: The number of highly qualified experts appointed and retained by the Under Secretary under subsection (b)(1) shall not exceed 25 at any time.

dimensions.assessment: Provides flexible pay rates up to senior-level maximums to attract experts in needed occupations.
dimensions.evidence: prescribe the rates of basic pay for positions to which employees are appointed under paragraph (2) at rates not in excess of the maximum rate of basic pay authorized for senior-level positions

dimensions.assessment: Involves compensation up to the Vice President's salary for up to 25 individuals, but no total budget figure is provided.
dimensions.evidence: total annual compensation of the employee will exceed the maximum amount of total annual compensation payable to the Vice President

dimensions.assessment: Grants targeted hiring and pay-setting authorities to the Bureau of Industry and Security.
dimensions.evidence: appoint personnel from outside the civil service... to positions in the Bureau of Industry and Security

dimensions.assessment: The authority ceases to be effective 5 years after enactment, though individual appointments can last up to 6 years with extensions.
dimensions.evidence: The authority provided by this section shall cease to be effective on the date that is 5 years after the date of the enactment of this section.

missing_information: Total projected cost of hiring these 25 experts.
Specific occupations or exact salary figures planned.
importance_detail.rationale: Authorizes the Under Secretary of Commerce for Industry and Security to appoint up to 25 highly qualified experts outside the civil service to address expertise gaps, lasting for a limited 5-year period.
